'''Kagamitsukurimake Shrine''' (かがみつくりまけじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Tawaramoto, Nara|arz|تاواراموتو|ceb|Tawaramoto-chō (subdistrito)|es|Tawaramoto (Nara)|fa|تاواراموتو، نارا|fr|Tawaramoto|hy|Տավարամոտո|it|Tawaramoto|ja|田原本町|ko|다와라모토정|mg|Tawaramoto|ms|Tawaramoto, Nara|my|တဝရမိုတိုမြို့၊ နာရ|pl|Tawaramoto|ru|Таварамото|sv|Tawaramoto|tl|Tawaramoto, Nara|tr|Tawaramoto|uk|Таварамото|ur|ٹاوارا موٹو، نارا|zh|田原本町|qid=Q1203159}}, {{ill|Shiki District, Nara|Q1155036|qid=Q1155036}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}. It is a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinai Shōsha}}, and its former rank was village shrine under the {{ill|Q712534|lt=modern shrine ranking system}}.

=== History ===
The founding date is unknown, but the enshrined deity Mahitsune-no-Mikoto is identified with Ame-no-Mahitotsu-no-Mikoto and regarded as a deity related to metalworking. This is said to derive from the continuity of metal casting in this Kagamitsukuri district: metal-casting groups for items such as {{ill|Dōtaku|ca|Dotaku|cs|Dótaku|de|Dōtaku|es|Dōtaku|fr|Dōtaku|hu|Dótaku|id|Dōtaku|it|Dōtaku|ja|銅鐸|ko|동탁 (유물)|ms|Dōtaku|pl|Dōtaku|pt|Dotaku|ru|Дотаку|sl|Dōtaku|uk|Дотаку|zh|銅鐸|qid=Q2312868}} at the {{ill|Karako-Kagi Site|ff|Karako-Kagi Site|ha|Shafin yanar gizon Karako-Kagi|ja|唐古・鍵遺跡|qid=Q11418520}} in the {{ill|Yayoi period|af|Yayoi-tydperk|ar|فترة يايوي|ast|Periodu Yayoi|az|Yayoy dövrü|ba|Яёй осоро|be|Яёй|bg|Яйои|bn|ইয়ায়োই যুগ|br|Marevezh Yayoi|ca|Període Yayoi|cs|Období Jajoi|de|Yayoi-Zeit|el|Περίοδος Γιαγιόι|eo|Jajoi-epoko|es|Período Yayoi|et|Yayoi ajastu|eu|Yayoi aroa|fa|دوره یایویی|fi|Yayoi-kausi|fr|Période Yayoi|he|תקופת יאיואי|hi|योयाई अवधि|hr|Yayoi|hu|Jajoi-kor|hy|Յայոյ ժամանակաշրջան|id|Zaman Yayoi|it|Periodo Yayoi|ja|弥生時代|jv|Jaman Yayoi|kn|ಯಾಯೋಯಿ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ|ko|야요이 시대|lt|Jajoi laikotarpis|ms|Zaman Yayoi|nl|Yayoiperiode|pl|Yayoi|pt|Período Yayoi|ro|Perioada Yayoi|ru|Период Яёй|sh|Yayoi period|simple|Yayoi period|sk|Obdobie Jajoi|sl|Obdobje Jajoi|sr|Јајои период|sv|Yayoi|th|ยุคยาโยอิ|tl|Panahong Yayoi|tr|Yayoi Dönemi|uk|Період Яйой|ur|یایوئی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Yayoi|war|Panahon Yayoi|wuu|弥生时代|zh|彌生時代|zh_min_nan|Yayoi sî-tāi|zh_yue|彌生時代|qid=Q207858}}, later inherited by the Kagamitsukuri-be in the {{ill|Kofun period|Q459939|qid=Q459939}}. In the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}} it was called "Koyasu-sha" and "Kasuga-sha," but after {{ill|Shinbutsu bunri|Q1970535|qid=Q1970535}} the shrine name was changed in {{ill|1869|Q7720|qid=Q7720}} (Meiji 2).
